reviews.text:
Ontario Hearing Center has been fabulous to work with.  We have been managing hearing aids and the associated professionals for over 25 years now.  This has been the best experience to date.

Thanks to the entire team for the outstanding service.

A very welcoming and pleasant office—I’m so glad I was referred! Dr. Adam Shepard was incredibly patient and took the time to explain everything about my hearing test and the results in a way that was easy to understand. I ended up purchasing new hearing aids and feel confident in my decision. Everything is working exactly as explained. Pam the office manager at the front desk was also so helpful and kind throughout the entire process. Highly recommend!
Friendly. No long waiting time. Very professional and helpful.
Very professional. Everyone was friendly. All my questions so far have been answered.

Excellent, courteous service from Dr. Orlando today for checking and cleaning my hearing aids after purchasing them 6 months ago. The blue tooth I-phone connection, the TV streaming and the rechargeable hearing aid dock enhanced my hearing immensely The upgrades were worth every penny..

Dr. Orlando is not just knowledgeable about Audiology. She is kind and caring as well. I have had nothing but positive interactions at Ontario Hearing since I started going there in 2021. Additionally, Pam is welcoming and efficient. Five out of five stars!

I recently returned to Rochester, NY and had a battery issue with my Starkey Hearing aide batteries and needed to find a a place that address this issue.  So glad I found Ontario Hearing Center… everyone there was so professional  and were able to send them in for battery replacements  and get them back to me within a week.  Great staff…. I am so glad I found them and will definitely be using them in the future!

I am a transplant from NewJersey
And need help with an issue I was having with my hearing aid.
To my pleasant surprise I was treated  as a regular customer.
Great customer service and with a smile. I have now found a home

I am a recent transplant from nj
With an issue with my hearing aids.
I went by Ontario hearing center at Monroe ave Rochester.
I was treated as if I was their regular customer.
What a pleasant experience.
They are now my hearing aid office
For life .
Always a great experience with Dr. Segmond and the front office staff.

Dr. McNamara is the best of the best! He is incredibly knowledgeable and a true expert of audiology. I could not trust my hearing needs to anyone more excellent than him. In addition, he has a delightful personality and takes whatever time you may need to answer all questions to make sure his clients understand the unique features of your hearing needs. His front desk secretary is always sweet and accommodating also.

I first started with Ontario Hearing Center in early 1967, when I was in kindergarten. It was known as Otarion Hearing at the time. I am approaching 60 years with them. I've seen the evolution of hearing aid and testing technology through all of those years. I have gone through some unique needs for testing, including meeting the requirements for FAA regulations as a Private Pilot and DOT regulations as a school bus driver. They have always come through with me with excellent service.

John McNamara really cares about his patients and has the skills and experience to help you achieve the best hearing results!! Sadly I have moved away and will miss my relationship with John and Ontario Hearing. If you have a hearing deficit and need help please call Ontario Hearing  you will be pleased. John is a true professional not a salesman.
These people are wonderful! My hearing aids work great!

I just completed my 1-year follow-up with Dr. Andrea Segmond. The entire experience with Dr. Segmond and the staff at Ontario Hearing over the year with my new hearing aids has been excellent. Everyone is thoughtful, patient, and thorough. The hearing tests and computerized equipment to setup and fine tune the hearing aids to my situation are very interesting. I can now hear better to participate in conversations where previously I was mostly an observer.
Excellent service and great people. Cannot recommend more!!

The best hearing office in Rochester NY.
Wonderful people!!!
Dr. McNamara was very thorough and personable in his approach to provide my wife with hearing aids that will improve her quality of life for a long time!

I have known Andrea Segmond for years and Ontario Hearing Centers was the first place I called when my hearing was clearly diminishing. She presented all of my options and I trusted her years of expertise when making my decision. I am so happy to fully hear again and encourage anyone facing hearing loss to call Ontario Hearing Centers. I recently moved my 85 year old mother to NY and she has her appointment scheduled!
Fast service and amazing staff. Thank you!

Would highly recommend Ontario Hearing Center.  I have known Dr. Andrea Segmond, for many years.  She took care of both my parents earring lost issues over the years.  When I, myself, was experiencing hearing lost, I knew exactly where I would feel comfortable going.  Her knowledge and patience is outstanding.  Being a bit of an 'iPhone user challenged', she took time with me to successfully show how to use it with my new hearing aids.  Thank you!
Dr. John McNamara is the best. He is honest, patient, kind, and very knowledgeable. I never feel rushed.

My 94 year old mother has been seeing Dr. Andrea Segmond for a number of years now.  She is the best! She is so caring and patient, and knowledgeable both technically and on a personal level.  She always takes the time to make everything the best it can be. We feel so lucky that we found her.

What a great experience! Andrea and the front desk peeps are wonderful! I left surprised and delighted with new hearings aids that have opened up a whole new world for me. Happy to know I’ll be a regular patient there!
I've been to the rest now go to the Best! Dr.Segmond will ensure you are satisfied.

I have worked with Andrea for six years and throughout that time I have become accustomed to exceptional patient care.  Andrea has always provided me with all of the information I could want about the status of my hearing loss and my treatment options.
I have very recently gotten new Oticon hearing aides and, in addition to the compassion, understanding and care I have always experienced- my new hearing aides have blown me out of the water.
I sit here tonight looking at that water, with the chorus of birds serenading the sunset, and distant murmurs of dogs and families settling in for the night.  The lake has settled yet I am able to hear its quiet lapping at the shore.  With my first hearing aides I rediscovered bird song.  With these new hearing aides the choral experience has a roundness and detail of sound that I barely remember.  I, as always, look forward to my grandchildren's summer arrival from Chicago, and this year I knowingly anticipate that I will hear the fullness of their child voices with delight.

I feel very fortunate that a friend recommended Ontario Hearing Center near 12 Corners in Brighton. Dr. Segmond has been so knowledgeable and patient in addressing my hearing challenges. I know I hear so much better because of the quality technology and superior customer service at Ontario.

My experience at Ontario Hearing Center was extraordinary.  I am a 70 year old female who no longer experiences any hearing loss thanks to the incredibly gracious, kind, proficient and professional staff at Ontario Hearing Center.  Dr. Andrea Segmund is absolutely amazing in her ability to understand people and provide for their hearing needs.   Facing hearing loss and the solution can be scary, but not if you are in their care.  I highly recommend Ontario Hearing Center to anyone who is willing to admit their need and accept the expertise the family at Ontario Hearing Center is able to competently provide.  I am confident you will not be disappointed.

The team at Ontario Hearing Centers made me feel like I was a priority - even on the first day, when I randomly walked in to their office.  They used state-of-the-art technology - not used by some other facilities - to improve my life.  I wholeheartedly recommend their services, should you need hearing help.  Thank you

I am very pleased with the service and professionalism of the Ontario Hearing Center staff. I am very pleased with how much time Dr. Andrea Segmond took with me in setting up my 2 Oticon aids and making sure I understood and was comfortable with them.  Follow up visits have been equally beneficial. I would recommend Ontario Hearing to anyone needing Hearing Aids.

I have been using hearing aids for quite a few years, and Ontario Hearing is top notch in every way- Andrea has been wonderful in terms of her caring, knowledge, and service.  If you think you have hearing issues, I would recommend this place as tops in all respects.

Our experience with Dr McNamara was amazing.  He is one of the very few doctors that perform REM (real ear measurements) , when fitting the new hearing aid.  This is key to getting the potential out of your device.  You could have a high quality hearing aid, but NOT have it adjusted and fine tuned to your specific needs, and the result would be no where near what you want.  I brought someone who was very sceptical that his severe hearing loss  could be improved due to his tinnitus, but with Dr. McNamara 's effort, his knowledge and obvious enthusiasm for what he can do for his patients... It's a new world.  I can't thank Dr McNamara enough.

I had purchased hearing aids at a business in the Rochester area and was not happy or satisfied with the service. I was referred to Ontario Hearing Center by a friend and I am very pleased with the professional service and exceptional patient care! They take the time, are available for support, and go above and beyond to make sure that patients are receiving the best possible care and are completely satisfied with the products they purchase from the moment you walk into the office. The Audiologist serving me and my needs is Dr Andrea Segmund - she's the best! I highly recommend Ontario Hearing Center of Brighton for all of your hearing aid needs and service!

Impressed with care I have received from Ontario Hearing. Staff is friendly. Office is clean and conveniently located. Scheduling is easy and have always been seen in a timely manner. Drs. Mcnamara and Segmond perform thorough exams and explain their findings in an understandable, professional manner. Thanks to their compassionate care,a world of many beautiful sounds has been opened to me.

I have been going to Ontario hearing center for about six years now and nothing but praise for them. If you have any hearing issues, go see them. ☺️
The location is convenient and easy to find. Plenty of parking.
They have technology that gives more information to the doctors. (I don't remember the name of it. Real Ear?) Other offices don't have it.
The staff is very friendly and helpful. I never have to wait long to be seen.  Dr. Segmund always gives plenty of time for questions and explains everything clearly.
She genuinely loves what she does and wants to help her clients hear the best they can.
Dr. Segmund is up on the latest research and enjoys sharing that knowledge.
After asking me questions about my lifestyle, she recommended a hearing aid (and receiver) best for me and my budget. A previous audiology center just wanted to sell me hearing aids.

Both myself and my husband go to the very capable hands of Dr. Andrea Segmund. We couldn’t have made a better choice. Everything is explained clearly and concisely and we are more than pleased with the care we continue to receive. Office staff is friendly and welcoming.

I have been wearing hearing aids for over 50 years.  I always had great difficulty understanding what I have heard.
I found Ontario Hearing,  John adjusted my hearing aid properly. My understanding of what is being said to me improved greatly. I have been going to Him ever since.

I office is very accommodating, helpful and pleasant.

Ontario Hearing is a rare gem. The audiologists truly care for each patient and provide the best care to assist them in being able to enjoy their families, hobbies and work environment through the gift of better hearing. The support staff is always kind and understanding of your needs.
They take care of my parents as if they were their own.

Convenient parking and I am seen within 5 minutes of appointment.  Dr. McNamara is positive and friendly and answers any questions, including anatomy of the ear and impact hearing on balance.
I like one of the sayings posted “ kindness is the language deaf people can hear and the blind can understand.”       Mark Twain
Very kind and professional staff
John and the staff are great. He got me into a product which vastly improved my quality of life and made the entire process seamless. Thanks!

I got my hearing aids several years ago from Ontario Hearing.  The process includes testing my hearing initially and periodically, showing me how to maintain the devices, periodic maintenance and checking of the devices etc.    Dr. Andrea has been great about these services.  Ontario's office staff and courteous and well organized.  I have been very satisfied with Ontario Hearing.
Dr. Andrea Segmund is an awesome audiologist.  She is very attentive and cares that the entire journey to better hearing is excellent.

Very happy with my experience at Ontario Hearing Center in Brighton.  The office staff is very attentive and helpful.  The audiologists that I’ve worked with are extremely experienced, accommodating, and caring.  I would highly recommend this office to anyone concerned about their hearing.

I have been a patient at Ontario Hearing Center on Monroe Avenue for over four years and am 100 % a satisfied and grateful customer. I was initially nervous about the whole process, but landed in the capable hands of Dr.Andea Segmond. I was impressed by her thoroughness, clear explanations, and determination to make adjustments to give me the greatest sound clarity. Information about costs and various brands of hearing aids were easy to understand. I was able to choose what I felt met my needs.
Follow up care is excellent. Everyone there is kind and helpful. It is a pleasure to go there.

Dr. Andrea Segmond and the whole staff at Ontario hearing are Fantastic!
They go above and beyond to ensure you are getting the best possible care for your situation.  When I experienced a sudden profound hearing loss, Dr Segmond was the most empathic, caring, competent, professional that I encountered. Together we explored many treatment options and I always feel like she not only has my best interests at heart but cares about improving my quality of life as much as I do.  The whole staff is always available in an emergency, and you are always treated with patience and kindness.  I have referred many family and friends to Ontario hearing and will continue to do so.

Dr. Andrea Segmond is very compassionate, understanding and a superb professional. We were given the most thorough evaluation with attention to every detail. She is skilled in fitting us to the hearing aids that are best for our circumstances and the activities we enjoy. We never felt rushed or pressured - she is patient in answering our questions and explains clearly how to operate, clean and care for our hearing aids. We feel supported with follow up care and the entire staff - especially Sheila - is so pleasant and accommodating and helpful. We highly recommend Dr. Segmond and Ontario Hearing Center.  Sue and Al Lipke
My Mom is 92 years old. She has been going here for many years. Everyone that works here is great! From the receptionist to the Drs. The care and knowledge they show is exceptional.
John McNamara and the team at Ontario hearing are top notch! Very professional, warm and friendly. Personalized service, you won’t be disappointed.

Recently bought my second set of HAs from Dc. Mcnamara and his staff. Which really says it all!  He and his staff,  took the time to properly fit, explain, and immediately schedule a followup visit.  Made sure that the HAs matched my hearing loss and just "took care" of me.  Completely earn my 5 star rating, you can't do better!  In fact, they now have their main office in SE Roch. , Monroe Ave., and another complete office in NW Rochester, Spencerport Rd.

The staff at Ontario Hearing Center was very helpful, friendly, and knowledgeable.  I was able to make an appointment to see the doctor in a reasonable amount of time.  The doctor was very thorough at my appointment and I was extremely satisfied with the treatment plan that was provided.  Highly recommend.

I was always impressed with the care that the staff at Ontario Hearing gave my mother. They were patient, caring, and very professional. So when I was in need of having my hearing checked, I called them. Once again I had a very caring and professional experience. I love my hearing aids and the added quality they have brought to my life. Thank you!

I have been a loyal patron of Ontario Hearing Center for almost 30 years.  I can't imagine being anywhere else for my evaluations and hearing aids.  Everything from the staff personality, professionalism,  expertise, warmth, service,  and cutting edge  knowledge  and technology,  has been part of my service and relationship with them.  They have supported me throughout the years as my hearing needs have  changed .  I have the utmost confidence and knowledge I receive top notch care in every way.  I can't give a higher recommendation.
So informative, helpful and caring!!!  Ask a question, you get an answer!  My hearing is so much better!!!

The caring and remarkable service we received here was unsurpassed. We had a situation just minutes before they stopped seeing patients  and they fit us in with professionalism and kindness! This kind of treatment is rare and the charges were equally fare. Grateful for this experience as we were here from Kansas visiting family needing my hearing aids to work!
Dr. Segmond is an excellent! She is thorough, personable, and consistently goes above and beyond.
Wonderful personilized service!

My entire family (3 generations) have been going to Ontario Hearing Instruments for almost 20 years. Every aspect of our experience has been incredible. The staff is amazing. Dr. Segmund is almost like a family member to us. She truly understands our challenges and is ALWAYS looking for the best possible solutions for our hearing loss. I can't even count the number of times she has said something to the effect of: "I was at this conference and saw this and thought specifically of you and your dad - I think this would really help". My hearing loss has been in the "profound" range for years. I do not know how I could have managed this more effectively than I have with the help of Ontario Hearing. I have recommended their services many times for many people and will continue to do so. Definitely worth looking into. They truly provide amazing service to all their patients.

I recently moved back to Rochester and began going to Ontario Hearing Center and was extremely impressed by their professionalism and knowledge in the audiology field. Their state of the art technology surpassed my previous audiologist's. It was so nice being able to talk and be heard by the doctors. I really felt like they cared. Great place!

Kate Van Cura

Well, I just turned 60 and decided to have my hearing tested. The good news is I needed hearing aids. I say good news because I can't believe how much better I can hear now. Dr. John McNamara was so knowledgeable and helped me select the proper hearing aids for my hearing loss. No more saying "What?", and I can finally hear the TV at a normal volume. Fantastic service and support from a well run office.

The service and attention I received by the entire staff were exemplary! Dr. Segmond was kind and patient as she explained the entire process to me- from the exam, results, and hearing aid selection to the fitting, personalizing, and even setting up my iPhone app! I have already recommended her to my family and friends.

Andrea is wonderful!  I have been a client on Ontario Hearing for about 15 years.  The staff are friendly and efficient.  I have purchased 3 or 4 pairs of hearing aids here.  Each time, Andrea makes sure my devices are working properly and fit well.  I will continue to recommend Ontario Hearing.

Dr. Segmond and Dr. McNamara have gone above and beyond to deal with the manufacturer to address some unusual circumstances regarding my hearing aids.

I have been seeing them for more than 10 years and have found them to be experts in their field. Their diagnostic equipment is second to none and I have recommended them to friends who have hearing issues.

Personnel is very efficient and friendly.
John is knowledgeable.  He advises his patient to the best product for their needs.  He is easy going and explains in detail how the product works and how that product is the best for the patient.
John runs a clean efficient, pleasant workplace.

Dr John MacNamara and his entire team are consummate professionals. With my having genetic hearing loss my entire life, it was not until I connected with Ontario Hearing Centers and John MacNamara that I truly fully appreciated what I had been missing. Best in Class Audiologist Team !!
John and his staff are always friendly and professional making all of their customers comfortable and welcomed!
I have known Dr. McNamara  for over thirty some years and I wouldn’t go to anyone else in the world he is outstanding and always open to my concerns

Both my grandparents see Dr. McNamara for their hearing loss. After their hearing test with Dr. McNamara they decided the best route was hearing aids. The hearing aids have helped them tremendously. He’s been very patient and walked them through all the technology so that they are comfortable. He’s a wonderful audiologist and my grandparents thinks so too!
Dr. John McNamara and his staff are incredibly helpful and reliable. He is very trustworthy and knowledgeable. I highly recommend him for anyone who is having hearing problems.

Great experience! Dr. McNamara is capable,  thorough, and articulate.  Someone from each generation in our family has been to see Dr. McNamara and he has delivered outstanding care to each person. I highly recommend Ontario Hearing!

I can't say enough about Dr. McNamara and the entire staff at Ontario hearing instruments.  My grandfather had his hearing tested and was fitted with a new device, and he raved about his experience!  Everyone was extremely friendly and helpful, and his new hearing aid was much more comfortable than the old device.  I would recommend Dr. McNamara to anyone concerned about their hearing loss.
I had such a wonderful experience.  Being young, I was hesitant to commit to wearing a hearing aid. The staff put my fears to rest and fitted me with the perfect device.  Highly recommended!

This was a great experience. The office staff was very friendly. Everything was very clean. I did not have to wait at all. The care I received for my hearing issue was  phenomenal. The equipment they had was top of the line. everything Dr. McNamara did was explained in a way that made it very easy to understand. He quickly diagnosed and treated my problem. I really feel he went above and beyond with providing good care to me. I would definitely recommend this office if you are in need of an audiologist.
Wonderful experience, very attentive to my needs
Excellent professional staff and facilities

I received my first hearing aid ever in 2012  from Dr. Andrea Segmond at Ontario Hearing, after interviewing 5 other centers.  Dr. Segmond has been taking care of my and my husband's ears ever since then.  Dr Segmond  is outstanding in pre-screening and meticulous testing, outstanding in follow-up, providing many sessions to fine-tune my hearing aid. She fitted me with a Widex aid, which I like.  She is  knowledgeable, and caring, and gives thorough explanations. She is a pleasure to work with. She is still there for me six years later if I need anything at all.  (Note: I've occasionally needed an appointment when she isn't there, and Dr. MacNamara is also excellent, competent, meticulous and congenial).
On Monroe ave
Great, friendly, personal service.
